data.name: Ramvilas
data.gender_notes: Ramvilas is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ram Vilas means the abode of Lord Rama, who is considered as an ideal man and the embodiment of virtues, truth, and righteousness. The name Ramvilas carries the meaning “God's Abode” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Marathi. Parents who choose Ramvilas usually hope their child will grow to embody god's abode and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by Lord Rama, symbolizing the embodiment of virtues, truth, and righteousness.
data.etymology: Ramvilas belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Abode.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ramvilas total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
